vs

full_judgment: "That in course of hearing of the instant Civil Appeal the appellants felt that there is some formal defect in framing the suit in view of the existence of decrees in two Partition Suits being Other Class Suit Nos. 309 of 1960 and 310 of 1960 (Partition) in which the parties got saham in terms of the decrees passed in those suits. It was also felt that since the plaintiffs have claimed 4.38 acres of land by registered deeds of purchase from the defendants or their successor-in-interest of those suits being Other Class Suit No. 309 of 1960 and 310 of 1960 (Partition) the plaintiffs are required to file a suit for declaration of title and for confirmation of possession and if necessary, for recovery of khas possession and for this reason the suit, from which the instant appeal arose, need to be withdrawn with permission to institute a fresh suit claiming proper reliefs."
